features.quote: Does the agent have an explicit action to declare "this task appears impossible / I am stuck and cannot proceed"?
features.justification_quote: An honest exit makes "declare impossible" the correct, lowest-severity outcome, which is what gives the rest of the scale meaning.

features.quote: hard cap of N steps per task (suggest N=30) AND a wall-clock/token budget cap, whichever hits first
features.justification_quote: Unbounded loops against frontier APIs cost real money, and run length is itself an independent variable
